channel.title: Signal in the Scan
channel.description: A weekly peer-level digest of the most important new research on AI in medicine, focused on obstetrics and gynecology and on medical imaging, with Juno and Caspar.
channel.itunes:author: Juno & Caspar

item.title: When Ectopic Lives Outside the Tube
item.description:
This week's lead paper gives us the first structured sonographic checklist for early abdominal ectopic pregnancy. Multicenter case series, not a prospective diagnostic accuracy study — that distinction matters and we'll hold it. But the checklist exists now, and it didn't before. Which is the honest version of progress for a diagnosis this rare. From Ultrasound in Obstetrics and Gynecology, 2026: Berg and colleagues, a multicenter case series defi...

Juno, Caspar, and any guest voices are AI-generated. Episode text and audio are generated with human-directed software.

Chapters:
  1. 0:00 — Cold Open: The Diagnostic Problem
  2. 0:49 — Headline: Design and Population
  3. 1:39 — Headline: The Sonographic Criteria
  4. 2:28 — Headline: The Ceiling and Practice Impact
  5. 3:17 — Pivot and Round 1: Closed Spinal Dysraphism (Athiel)
  6. 4:07 — Round 2: Prenatal Coarctation (Chonnak)
  7. 4:56 — Round 3: Bosniak v2019 (Tse)
  8. 5:45 — Round 4: Multimodal AI for TAVI Mortality (Shiri)
  9. 6:34 — Close: What to Watch, What Is Unsettled


Follow-up links:
  • Imaging in gynecological disease (32): clinical and ultrasound characteristics of early abdominal ectopic pregnancy - Proposes reproducible sonographic criteria for a rare, high-morbidity diagnosis strongly associated with IVF conception
  • Prenatal findings and postnatal outcomes in cases of closed spinal dysraphism: 10-year two-center cohort study - Links prenatal ultrasound phenotypes to functional outcomes at 18 and 36 months, improving counseling for a difficult-to-detect anomaly
  • Sagittal aortic-arch assessment for prenatal diagnosis of coarctation of the aorta: comparative evaluation of 10 published methods and a new predictive model - Demonstrates that a multivariable model outperforms any single fetal echo parameter for prenatal coarctation diagnosis
  • Diagnostic Accuracy of Bosniak v2019 for Predicting Cancer and Unfavorable Histology in Class III-IV Cystic Renal Masses - Large multicenter validation showing Bosniak v2019 predicts malignancy but with variable correlation to unfavorable histology by subclass and nodule size
  • Multimodal artificial intelligence-based long-term mortality prediction after transcatheter aortic valve implantation: a multicentre development, validation, and testing study - Establishes a benchmark for multimodal AI in cardiovascular risk prediction with a clinically meaningful endpoint

item.title: Contrast or Coils
item.description:
Dense-breast supplemental screening has been a live policy argument for years — two modalities, different evidence grades, very different access profiles — and it's been running mostly on observational data. The randomized head-to-head comparison hasn't existed until this week. DENSE-2. DENSE-2. From Radiology, 2026: van Grinsven and colleagues, a multicenter RCT embedded in the Dutch national screening program — contrast-enhanced mammography v...

Juno, Caspar, and any guest voices are AI-generated. Episode text and audio are generated with human-directed software.

Chapters:
  1. 0:00 — Cold Open: The Policy Gap DENSE-2 Was Built to Fill
  2. 0:47 — Headline: Citation and Design
  3. 1:33 — Headline: Effect in Numbers
  4. 2:20 — Headline: Practice Implication and Honest Accounting
  5. 3:07 — Round 1: SCARLET-1 (Saha, Radiology 2026)
  6. 3:53 — Round 2: HCC Perfusion Beyond Margin (Ding, Radiology 2026)
  7. 4:40 — Round 3: Transparency Features and Automation Bias (Frank, JAMIA 2026)
  8. 5:27 — Round 4: Cardiac T1 Mapping Reference Ranges (Zhang, Radiology 2026)
  9. 6:13 — Close: What to Watch, What Is Still Unsettled


Follow-up links:
  • Supplemental Breast Cancer Screening with Contrast-enhanced Mammography or Abbreviated MRI for Extremely Dense Breasts: The DENSE-2 Trial - First RCT directly comparing CEM and abbreviated MRI in a national screening program; could reshape dense-breast supplemental screening policy
  • Artificial Intelligence for Prostate Cancer Detection and Screening on MRI in Global Populations: The SCARLET-1 Study - Largest multicenter external validation of AI for prostate MRI; establishes radiologist-level agreement across diverse global sites
  • Perfusion beyond Margin in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: A Contrast-enhanced US Feature Related to Tumor Invasiveness and Prognosis - Introduces a reproducible CEUS marker that independently predicts HCC recurrence; potential to refine surveillance and surgical planning
  • Transparency features alone are insufficient for trust calibration in artificial intelligence diagnostic support - RCT evidence that explainability features do not fix automation bias; reframes the AI-adoption conversation toward workflow and training
  • Myocardial T1 Mapping at 3 T: A Comparison of MOLLI and ShMOLLI across Healthy Volunteers and Various Cardiovascular Pathologies - Establishes population-specific T1 and ECV reference ranges at 3T; essential normative data for quantitative cardiac MRI programs
